justification: The product of (1 + 1/n) over n = 1..m telescopes to m + 1 and diverges, so the claim that it stays near 1 because the factors tend to 1 is false as written. The statement itself is refuted by the admissible equality sequence x_n = n: it satisfies x_1 = 1 and 0 <= x_{n+1} <= (1 + 1/n) x_n with equality, yet sup_n x_n is infinite rather than at most 2.
